values.responses.response-weekend.question: I cannot visit the government service center on weekdays. Can I apply on weekends?
values.responses.response-weekend.answer: The city government service center offers Saturday appointments for selected frequently used services. First check the relevant notices and service guides on this website to confirm which applications are accepted, then make an appointment through the center's advice counter. Services requiring checks across departments continue to follow weekday procedures.
values.responses.response-elderly.question: How can an older family member apply for community meal services?
values.responses.response-elderly.answer: Ask the community service station where the older person lives about nearby meal providers, their service areas, meal times, and charges. Registration usually requires identity and residence information and details of meal needs. Staff will explain any additional conditions for meal delivery or special support.
values.responses.response-training.question: Where can I find training programs to improve my vocational skills?
values.responses.response-training.answer: Read the application steps in the Employment and entrepreneurship service guide on this website, then ask a public employment service counter about current training programs. Bring proof of identity and explain your career interests and learning needs. Staff can help match you with courses and check eligibility.
values.info.disclosure.title: Government information disclosure
values.info.disclosure.body:
Openness is the default. Policy documents, government work reports, and information on priority areas concerning government work, public services, and social well-being are published promptly.

The homepage provides a disclosure guide, disclosure directory, annual government work reports, budgets, and final accounts. The policy document library supports searches by keyword and section.
values.info.guide.title: Information disclosure guide
values.info.guide.body:
This section explains what government information is disclosed, how to access it, and how to make an information request. Proactively disclosed information includes organizational responsibilities, regulatory documents, plans, financial information, and public services.

Select Policy document library on the homepage to search sample policies. For information that has not been proactively disclosed, see Information requests.
values.info.directory.title: Information disclosure directory
values.info.directory.body:
The disclosure directory covers organizational information, policies and regulations, government work reports, budgets and final accounts, major projects, social well-being, and public services.

The directory is organized by topic to help residents find information quickly. This sample portal provides policy documents, policy explanations, and service guides.
values.info.report.title: Government work report
values.info.report.body:
In 2026, Yanyang is pursuing quality development while prioritizing the protection and improvement of people's lives. Work continues on urban renewal, environmental protection, and digital government.

Key tasks include improving the business environment and support throughout a business's life cycle; creating a livable city through neighborhood renewal and convenient facilities; and strengthening public services in education, healthcare, and elderly care.

In the next phase, residents' and businesses' actual experiences will be the measure of success, ensuring that public welfare initiatives deliver practical results.
values.info.finance.title: Budgets and final accounts
values.info.finance.body:
This section presents annual budgets, budget execution, and final accounts to help the public understand how public funds are allocated and used.

Disclosures cover general public budgets, government fund budgets, departmental budgets, and spending on official overseas travel, vehicles, and hospitality. This sample does not use actual financial data.
values.info.key-areas.title: Disclosure in priority areas
values.info.key-areas.body:
The focus is on matters of public concern, including education, healthcare, social security, housing support, the environment, and major construction projects.

See Community news and Policy explanations for related sample information, or Government services for application guides.
values.info.application.title: Information requests
values.info.application.body:
Describe the information you need accurately, giving its name, document number, or other helpful search clues, and choose a convenient way to receive it.

After acceptance, the request will be reviewed under the relevant rules to determine whether the information can be disclosed, with a reply within the statutory period. This sample page does not accept actual information requests.
values.info.one-service.title: Complete related tasks efficiently in one process
values.info.one-service.body:
Related procedures are brought together around the needs of residents and businesses: one explanation of requirements, one application form, one set of documents, and one service counter.

Common services include starting a business, employment and entrepreneurship, social security, school enrollment, and elderly care. Select a service below to view its document checklist and procedure.
values.info.survey.title: Public consultation
values.info.survey.body:
Let your voice shape the city. We are collecting residents' suggestions on improving community public spaces, greener travel, and meal services for older people.

Consultation period: October 10–31, 2026. Please offer specific suggestions about user experience, facility locations, and service arrangements. Suggestions submitted below are reviewed by this website's administrators and are not displayed publicly. They are not formal government applications.
values.info.interaction.title: Public engagement
values.info.interaction.body:
This section provides answers to questions, public consultations, and message records to help residents explore issues they care about.

Use Leave a message to submit suggestions, questions, or feedback. Administrators can review them in the administration area, and messages are not displayed publicly. Responding to concerns on the homepage provides sample answers about school enrollment, bus routes, elderly care, and other common topics.
values.info.organization.title: Organizations and responsibilities
values.info.organization.body:
Yanyang United Government coordinates economic development, urban and rural construction, social affairs, and public services across the city. The city government service center is responsible for integrated counters, advice, and coordination of procedures.

Departments covering education, civil affairs, human resources and social security, housing and urban-rural development, transport, and the environment provide services and information within their responsibilities. The organizations and responsibilities shown on this website are examples.
values.info.sitemap.title: Site map
values.info.sitemap.body: The homepage includes government news, government transparency, government services, public engagement, city views, and special features. Use the links below to visit the relevant section.
values.info.help.title: Website help
values.info.help.body:
Finding information: Enter a keyword in the search box at the top or select a popular search term. Results can be filtered by sections such as policy documents and policy explanations.

Reading and services: Select a news headline to read the full article. Select a service icon to see required documents and application steps. Close details using the button at the upper right or the Esc key.

Messages: Enter a title and message under Leave a message, then submit. Administrators can read it; the content is not public. Keep your receipt number after a successful submission. Older locally stored messages are not submitted automatically.

Display settings: Senior mode at the top enlarges the interface. Accessibility improves link visibility and reading contrast. Use the dots and arrows below the city images to switch between them.
values.info.topics.title: Special features
values.info.topics.body: Special features bring together news and policies on the business environment, green development, and digital government. Choose a topic of interest from the feature cards on the homepage.
